newsitem.title: GREECE: PROSPECTS FOR FASTER 97 GDP GROWTH ARE SLIM - IOBE.
newsitem.headline: PROSPECTS FOR FASTER 97 GDP GROWTH ARE SLIM - IOBE.

text.p: Greece's GDP growth will be slightly higher than 2.0 percent in 1996 but prospects for faster economic growth in 1997 are slim, said private Industrial and Economic Research (IOBE) in its quarterly report.

Private consumption and strong investment spending on construction accounted mainly for the pick up in economic activity in 1996. But private investment spending on other fields slowed down and import penetration continued, it said.
The official projection is for GDP growth of 2.6 percent in 1996, up from 2.0 percent in 1995. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
